secrets.name: The Root Balcony
secrets.text: At the top of the stair in the wall a balcony hangs just under the lawn, and the roots of the garden come down around you like rain that has stopped. From here the trees are the right way up, very nearly.

meta.label: The Ceiling Garden
meta.blurb: The garden is on the ceiling. The trees hang down over the reading tables, and the fountain has decided to go up.
